system.description: The Stormkelt prays to Enken and is granted courage for himself or bestows courage upon a chosen individual. The person who is granted this power receives the exceptional trait of Psyche +8 for the ability’s duration. Even the dimwalker (if the Stormkelt offered the power to someone else) and up to two friends within range also receive a lesser exceptional trait of Psyche +4 for the ability’s duration.
